name: proto-blocks/oit-breadcrumbs-eyebrow-title
title: OIT Breadcrumbs + Eyebrow + Title
description: Top-of-page block for single resources. Light-grey to white gradient background with breadcrumbs (Home > Resource Library > current), then a white rounded card containing a red uppercase eyebrow (auto from Resource Type) and the post title, both centered. Use as the first block in the resource template.

eyebrowOverride.label: Eyebrow override
eyebrowOverride.help: Leave empty to auto-fill from the post's Resource Type. Set to override per-post.

titleOverride.label: Title override
titleOverride.help: Leave empty to use the post title.
